execution_gates: Independent PASS of this exact R4.1 amendment/hash before fixture generation or execution.
Implement one fixture family at a time: applied-parameter first, proof-domain second.
Independently review each fixture's bytes and bindings before simulator execution.
Each case requires an accepted positive control with its own policy ID/witness binding verified; a valid canonical harness control alone is insufficient.
Every positive, negative, and mutant control must rebind its transaction mint ID to its own compiled applied policy ID and V3 witness hash.
Each negative must invoke compiled Mint[0] and be attributable to the preserved named assertion; if attribution is unavailable or ambiguous, retain PENDING.
Use ephemeral test keys only; never read, export, derive, or persist original committee or wallet credentials.
Require valid final-body-bound funding witnesses and exact value conservation.
No inference of original-policy, full ledger admission, or live-network credit.

For applied_keys_bad_count and applied_keys_bad_length, require first-failure evidence from the unmodified target tied to the exact program bytes and Mint[0] input; if unavailable or ambiguous, keep PENDING and do not substitute an impossible one-guard mutant acceptance.
